# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.

# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.

POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

def proximity_of(mean_latency_ms: float) -> float:
    scaled = mean_latency_ms / 36.0
    return 1.0 - min(scaled, 1.0)

def node_peak(node: NodeState, pod: Pod) -> float:
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    return max(cpu_after, mem_after)

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    peak = node_peak(node, pod)
    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    # Convex reward for real post-placement headroom: bursts are what turn
    # into queueing delay and timeouts, so the marginal value of free capacity
    # rises sharply as utilisation approaches saturation.
    headroom = 1.0 - peak
    headroom_term = headroom * (0.25 + 0.75 * headroom)

    # Rate-weighted mean latency and worst individual link to already-placed
    # call-graph neighbours. Cross-tier links are what time out, so the worst
    # link must pull the score down even when the mean looks acceptable.
    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    max_latency = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
                lat = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weighted = weighted + rate * lat
                weight = weight + rate
                max_latency = max(max_latency, lat)

    # A pod with no placed neighbours yet gets a neutral 0.5 rather than a free 1.0:
    # rewarding "no neighbours" would bias the very first replica of every service.
    proximity = 0.5
    if weight > 0.0:
        mean_latency = weighted / weight
        mean_prox = proximity_of(mean_latency)
        max_prox = 1.0 - min(max_latency / 45.0, 1.0)
        proximity = mean_prox * 0.45 + max_prox * 0.55

    # Idle draw spans 1.8 W (far edge) to 108 W (the dev-1 fog server); keep this
    # term small so it only breaks ties among latency-comparable placements.
    efficiency = 1.0 - min(node.power_idle_w / 130.0, 1.0)
    return headroom_term * 0.62 + proximity * 0.34 + efficiency * 0.04

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    edges = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out
        source_pod = state.pods[graph.src[e]]
        destination_pod = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]
        eligible = (
            source_pod.current_node >= 0
            and destination_pod.current_node >= 0
            and source_pod.current_node != destination_pod.current_node
        )
        if eligible:
            src_node = state.nodes[source_pod.current_node]
            dest_node = state.nodes[destination_pod.current_node]
            link_latency = src_node.latency_to_ms[destination_pod.current_node]
            source_movable = not source_pod.stateful and not source_pod.has_pdb
            dest_movable = not destination_pod.stateful and not destination_pod.has_pdb
            dest_peak = 1.0
            src_peak = 1.0
            if source_movable:
                dest_peak = node_peak(dest_node, source_pod)
            if dest_movable:
                src_peak = node_peak(src_node, destination_pod)

            # and only when the receiving node keeps real post-move margin.
            worth_pulling = link_latency > 8.0

            pull_dest = worth_pulling and dest_movable and not src_node.suspended and src_peak < 0.55
            if pull_source and pull_dest:

                    moved = moved + 1
                else:
                    out.append(move_pod(destination_pod.id, source_pod.current_node))
                    moved = moved + 1
            elif pull_source:
                out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, destination_pod.current_node))
                moved = moved + 1
            elif pull_dest:
                out.append(move_pod(destination_pod.id, source_pod.current_node))
                moved = moved + 1
    return out

    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap

    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    peak = node_peak(node, pod)
    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    headroom = 1.0 - peak
    headroom_term = headroom * (0.10 + 0.90 * headroom)

    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    max_latency = 0.0

        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]

            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
                lat = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weighted = weighted + rate * lat
